answers.core: To improve static typing / type hinting further and make GDScript more friendly to newcomers.
answers.workaround:
Workaround shown on #632 like: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/632#issuecomment-869000807 > > This will give you the code hinting at least, and it makes sure it's of that type: > > ```gdscript > > for button in buttons: > > if button is Button: > > button.align = ALIGN_CENTER > > ``` > > This fails silently at run-time if the type doesn't match, so beware. A safer alternative for debug builds is: > > ```gdscript > for button in buttons: > assert(button is Button) > button.align = ALIGN_CENTER > ``` Do work and is clear. (indeed `assert()` is absolutely needed) ![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/assets/26041217/60463698-151d-48f7-9c44-ea2f1c5be74a) But then, whole idea of #632 is lost in vein as we aren't using the static typing.
